name: Loan
definition: Act of provding an amount of money, a property or other material goods to a another party in exchange for future repayment of the principal amount along with interest or other finance charges.

PrincipalAmount.name: Principal Amount
PrincipalAmount.definition: Amount of money borrowed, or part of that amount which remains unpaid (excluding interest).

InterestPaymentsSchedule.name: Interest Payments Schedule
InterestPaymentsSchedule.definition: Schedule for the payment of the interests due on the loan.
